product.description: În vara agitată a anului 1974, Kate Mularkey pare că s-a împăcat cu faptul că viața nu are să-i ofere nimic special. Dar, spre uimirea sa, „cea mai grozavă fată din lume“ se mută pe strada ei și vrea să-i fie prietenă. Tully Hart pare să aibă totul: frumusețe, inteligență, ambiție. La prima vedere, cele două fete sunt cât se poate de diferite: Kate, condamnată să fie veșnic o ființă obișnuită, cu o familie iubitoare care o umilește în permanență; Tully, plină de strălucire și mister, dar cu un secret care o distruge. Ele fac un pact pentru a fi cele mai bune prietene pe vecie, iar până la sfârșitul verii devin de nedespărțit.Timp de treizeci de ani, Tully și Kate se sprijină una pe alta, trecând printr-o mulțime de evenimente și stări care le pun la încercare prietenia: gelozie, furie, durere, resentimente. Și cred că au supraviețuit tuturor încercărilor vieții până când un singur act de trădare le va despărți... și le va supune curajul și prietenia la testul final.Scris de autoarea bestsellerului Privighetoarea, Aleea cu licurici este un roman impresionant despre promisiuni, secrete și trădări, despre dragoste, pierdere și magia prieteniei...„Romanul lui Kristin Hannah este un portret emoţionant şi realist al unei prietenii complexe şi trainice.“Booklist„O epopee remarcabilă a prieteniei dintre două fete nedespărțite, care trec împreună printr-o mulțime de peripeții şi de evenimente tragice... o poveste în care fanii vor recunoaște stilul inconfundabil al lui Kristin Hannah.“ The Seattle TimesKristin Hannah este autoarea bestsellerurilor Privighetoarea și A doua șansă.

# Aleea cu licurici by Litera: An Epic Novel of Friendship, Secrets, and Betrayal

Dive into the deeply emotional world of *Aleea cu licurici*. This stunning literary novel from acclaimed author Kristin Hannah is an unforgettable portrait of female friendship. If you are searching for a story that explores the complexities of lifelong bonds, enduring secrets, and the difficult journey toward self-discovery, this book is required reading.

***

## The Story: A Lifelong Promise Tested by Time

The summer of 1974 sets the stage for two lives destined to become inextricably linked. Meet Kate Mularkey, who feels perpetually ordinary, living a life overshadowed by her loving family. Then there is Tully Hartâa woman possessing undeniable brilliance, beauty, and ambition, yet harboring a devastating secret.

At first glance, Kate and Tully could not be more different. They find each other, forging a pact to be the best of friends forever. By the end of that summer, their bond feels unbreakable.

Over the next thirty years, *Aleea cu licurici* follows their journey as they navigate life's most challenging terrain. Their friendship is tested by every emotion imaginable: intense jealousy, blinding rage, deep pain, and simmering resentments. As they face a multitude of pivotal events, their bond seems resilient enough to survive anythingâuntil one single act of betrayal threatens to tear them apart, forcing both the fragile thread of their friendship and the strength of their individual courage to the ultimate test.

## Why Readers Are Captivated by This Friendship Story

Kristin Hannah is celebrated for her ability to craft emotional realism, making this novel a masterpiece of connection and loss. It is more than just a story about two friends; it is an epic exploration of what it means to commit oneself to another person across decades.

*   **A Study in Bonds:** As critics have noted, the book is "an emotional and realistic portrait of a complex and enduring friendship" (*Booklist*).
*   **Unforgettable Characters:** Readers are drawn into the lives of two women whose contrasting personalities create powerful dramatic tension.
*   **Themes of Growth:** This novel masterfully tackles themes of sacrifice, the weight of keeping secrets, finding your true self, and the resilience required to survive trauma.

If you enjoyed Kristin Hannah's other bestsellers like *Privighetoarea* or *A doua ÈansÄ*, this book promises an equally moving reading experience.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is this a fast-paced mystery?**
A: While the story contains elements of mystery and secrets, it is primarily an emotionally rich literary drama. The focus is on the evolution of character and the profound nature of friendship over time, rather than solving a crime.

**Q: Is *Aleea cu licurici* suitable for all ages?**
A: As a deeply emotional novel dealing with complex themes like betrayal, loss, and maturity, it is best suited for adult readers who appreciate literary fiction and dramatic character studies.
